title: Triage runs each roadmap push in its own call
why: Triage mistake 23:14 CST Nov 8: it ran commit and push in one Bash call, against its handoff's rule (push alone, so a non-fast-forward refusal is read and rebased before anything else runs). No harm: the push went through.
note: Low value for a hook; a candidate for the triage brief's checklist instead. Decide at the next cull.
